WatchHome.pageTitle: Matamata i te Jesus Film Project

WatchFooter.home: Te kāiga o Jesus Film Project

WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Fausia mō misiona i te lalolagi katoa
WatchHomePromo.title: E se suia te feau. E suia te auala e matamata ei tino.
WatchHomePromo.description: Kua toe fau a tatou video library mo meafaigaluega mai te amataga, ma tuku atu te galuega fakaliliu e fia sefulu tausaga ki platform e masani ne fakapotopoto, matamata, mo tufa ei tino.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Te video library e sili atu te tele o ana translation i te lalolagi
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: E fia sefulu tausaga o galuega fakaliliu, ne ave ne ministry partners fakatuatuagina, ne fau ei se library mo e fia afe language tracks ke mafai o fetaiai tino mo te tala o Iesu i te language e sili ona oki atu ki loto i a latou.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Ave a leo fakatuatuagina ki formats fou
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Kua toe fau ne matou te auala e fakamatala ei a tala o te gospel i ata, ma fakafesui a translations fakatuatuagina mo formats fou ke mafai o see fua te feau i platform, aganuu, mo screens katoa.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: E sili atu i se library. Se team e fakavae ki te misiona.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project se team lalolagi o translators, media specialists, editors, mo creators e liliu te fāesaga o galuega ministry e fia sefulu tausaga ki meafaigaluega mō tino fai-disiple i so se koga.
WatchHomePromo.buildingNext: Mea e fau i te taimi nei
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Fakafesoʻotaʻi tino matamata ki avanoa tonu i tena faigamalaga fakalaumalie, ke fesoasoani ki a latou o fai te sitepu sosoa ki te community, Scripture, io me te mission.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryTitle: Media Library mō te Talai Telei
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Se media library faka-Kerisiano telā e tele, mo e fia afe vitio, films, mo resources e maua i languages e uke mō galuega ministry mo evangelism i te lalolagi katoa.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Video management, content distribution, audience engagement, mo analytics ne fuafua ke fesoasoani ki ministries o aapa atu ki tino e tokouke atu i se auala lelei.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Fesoasoani ke fau <highlight>te tupulaga fou</highlight> o mission tools
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: E fakaafe ne matou a practitioners, creators, mo partners ki te early access. Tofo muamua meafaigaluega fou, tuku mai se feedback, mo fesoasoani ke fau a products e fuafuaina mō galuega misiona tonu.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleEyebrow: Fakaputuga o te Tusi Tapu i Vitio
WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Saili a matou collection o vitio mo resources e fakaola mai te Tusi Tapu i tala mo akoakoga e manakogina.
WatchHomeSections.showcaseTitle: Te Tusi Tapu e fakamatala mai i ata tifaga
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Fakatasi mai i a matou Advent journey mo se vitio i aso taki tasi e fau ei te manako mō Christmas, ma sukesuke te faamoemoega, te fiafia, mo te tala fakapapau o te taunuku mai o Iesu.
